statement: For the declared synthetic L1-style AR(1) positive control, a predeclared model-based interval compatible with the known generating dependence structure returns Supported--L1 under the declared synthetic boundary.

boundary.energy: Deterministic simulated percentage block contrasts; no physical GPU, meter or server energy is measured.
boundary.service: Synthetic protocol classification behavior for a declared 150-block AR(1) record.

threshold_rationale.status: Synthetic planning control; not a universal operational threshold.

boundary_declared.evidence: The synthetic energy and service boundary explicitly exclude physical energy.

required_gate_set_complete.evidence: The evaluator derives and compares the current release L1 registry gate set.

runtime_provenance_status.evidence: The deterministic generator, seed and exact AR(1) parameters are retained.

design_integrity.evidence: Stationary AR(1) control with fixed, declared generating parameters; no physical GPU mapping is represented.

mapping_period_separability.evidence: No GPU map or period factor occurs in the synthetic control.

serial_dependence_assessed.evidence: The generating AR(1)=0.65 dependence structure is predeclared and known for this model-matched control.

continuous_duration.evidence: The planned synthetic record contains 150 sequential blocks; no request-window duration claim is made.

telemetry_gap.evidence: No telemetry sampling occurs; the synthetic sequence is complete by construction.

endpoint_bracketing.evidence: No request-window integration occurs; the synthetic sequence has defined block endpoints.

integration_stability.evidence: No numerical power integration occurs; the declared statistic is the generated block mean.

fixed_work_unit.evidence: 150 generated blocks under fixed AR(1) parameters.

benefit_threshold.evidence: True 5% effect exceeds the declared 2% SESOI in the positive-control scenario.

interval_rule.evidence: Predeclared one-sided 95% normal lower bound using the exact AR(1) mean variance under the known generator.

dependence_compatible_interval.evidence: The interval matches the stationary AR(1)=0.65 generator by construction; this is not an estimated-data claim.

block_replication.evidence: 150 blocks are generated for each deterministic draw.

directional_agreement.evidence: The positive-control condition applies the declared 80% favorable-block guard.

permitted_wording: Supported only as a synthetic, model-matched L1-style protocol positive control; it does not establish a physical energy, meter, deployment or environmental effect.
